_comment: Provisional until G3 freezes them. Every threshold the checks use lives here.
_bad_flag_bits: 1 contaminated or bad pixels, 4 saturated, 8 near a border (Euclid MER photometry cookbook). Tier A: both flags zero. Tier B: none of these bits; blended and bright-star-mask bits allowed. Tier C: the rest, not used.
